name: relay
label: Relay
tagline: Claude keeps working while you are out

manifest.summary: A zero-token boss process that runs Claude sessions unattended. Mail it or WhatsApp it from your phone (a one-word command or a long request) or add tasks and goals here; it launches headless sessions on whichever account has room, hands over at 95 percent, and mails you the result.

features.name: Mail in, mail out
features.description: Write to the Relay Gmail from your own address (Outlook on the phone). Short commands (status, pause, stop 12...) or any request, which becomes a task. Only mail from an allowed sender with dmarc or dkim pass is read. Results come back in the same thread.

features.name: WhatsApp chat
features.description: The chat "Indeed" through Relay's own hidden Whatsie: plain messages go to one standing chat task (Haiku 5.5 low by default, resumed while under 40k context) that answers in a few short lines through an outbox; work goes to one Opus work task (new: ...). At most two WhatsApp tasks open. Sends pictures and files, and deletes its own messages.

features.name: Local chat and quick commands
features.description: Type local and a small Jan model (2B by default) answers the WhatsApp chat with no usage, knowing Relay, usage, Forge and the laptop's temperatures, CPU and GPU; it stands in by itself when Claude is out of usage, and claude switches back. Quick commands answer instantly without a model: command list, stats, top cpu or top gpu then kill 3, kill task 12, kill all, find report then send 2. Starts Jan's model server if it is down.

features.name: Boss line
features.description: On WhatsApp, boss <question> (or the word boss to switch every message there) goes straight to Relay's boss: what runs, ETAs, both usage meters, and steering (stop, retry, pause, resume, tell a running task, post on the crew board, queue a task). One lean Claude turn per question (no tools or settings, about 2k tokens) answers within about half a minute, starting with Boss:.

features.name: Boss
features.description: boss.py, the relay-boss user service: one tick a minute, reads files and meters, launches claude -p sessions (bypassPermissions) and watches them. Spends no tokens while waiting.

features.name: Account and effort picker
features.description: Emerson's pacing: none at 95 percent (99 weekly), none new from 92, one per 15 minutes from 70, warm-cache account preferred, else most headroom. Important = max effort, rest medium.

features.name: Hand-over
features.description: When a running session's account passes 95 percent it is stopped and resumed for one short turn to write its State, then the task continues on another account.

features.name: Long tasks
features.description: No session cap. After 25 sessions without finishing, a short review session reads what the task's sessions did (State moving, commits) and says continue or park; a park reason goes to WhatsApp. The same check every 10 sessions after that; both numbers are on the Settings panel. A session close to finishing may pass the context hand-over (relay finishing).

features.name: Goals
features.description: A goal gets short planning sessions that write 1 to 3 task files; it is only done when its check command passes (or, with no check, when the planner finds it met).

features.name: Terminal
features.description: relay status, relay "any request", relay < file: the same commands as mail.

features.name: Session commands
features.description: relay reply, send-file, unsend, inbox, chat-model: sessions write to an outbox the boss sends; only the boss touches the WhatsApp page.

manifest.data_dir: ~/.local/share/forge/relay (settings, state, events, goals/, tasks/, runs/, secrets/ mode 700)
known_gaps: The live Gmail test waits on Emerson's spare Gmail and app password; the parser and the sender check are unit-tested only.
A session that runs one silent command for over 20 minutes is treated as stuck (stall_minutes).
WhatsApp: 'Delete for everyone' was not offered for Relay's test files (it falls back to 'Delete for me'); the chat's step-up and work-slot paths are unit-tested, not yet seen live.
improvements: An ntfy or Telegram channel as one new file in channels/.
